scripts.dev: npm run content:export && node scripts/prepare-ocr.mjs && concurrently -k -n api,web "node --watch server/index.mjs" "vite --host 127.0.0.1"
scripts.build: npm run content:export && node scripts/prepare-ocr.mjs && tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/precache.mjs
scripts.test: npm run content:export && node --test tests/server.test.mjs && tsx --test tests/learning.test.ts tests/store.test.ts
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
